snippet.title: The Future is loading... - Can an App Predict Your Future? | Visual Novel (Indie Games)
snippet.description:
"A game about an all knowing phone app and soon to be graduates."

Congrats you're a grad!... Now what? 

Play as two friends who are trying to figure out their lives with the help of a seemingly all knowing phone app.

The future is loading... Are you ready for it?

A Game by snackpai.

The Future is loading...: https://snackpai.itch.io/the-future-is-loading

-Indie Games Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLagy2HvRoiuAzcnwM4ZXB4WtIyR_HE7Hx

-Indie Horror Games Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLagy2HvRoiuCP0P02J9PPDiPm-aLYBlGW

-Visual / Kinetic Novel Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLagy2HvRoiuCw5wEhr6TuJlLbv73mmbEW

This is a No Commentary Gameplay.
